description: This file handles AJAX functionality for Drupal views, including attaching behaviors to filters, pagers, and updating the browser URL.

classes.name: Drupal.views.ajaxView
classes.description: JavaScript object representing a specific view with AJAX capabilities.

methods.name: Drupal.views.ajaxView.prototype.attachExposedFormAjax
methods.description: Attaches AJAX behavior to exposed filter forms, excluding reset buttons.

methods.name: Drupal.views.ajaxView.prototype.filterNestedViews
methods.description: Returns false if the view is nested inside another view.

methods.name: Drupal.views.ajaxView.prototype.attachPagerAjax
methods.description: Attaches AJAX behavior to pager links within the view.

methods.name: Drupal.views.ajaxView.prototype.attachPagerLinkAjax
methods.description: Attaches AJAX behavior to a specific pager link.
